hook.name: Glow
hook.description: ERC-20 token (GLOW) combined with a Uniswap v4 hook that applies a 3% sell tax on ETH output, splitting proceeds 50/50 between burning ETH to the dead address and distributing ETH dividends to non-excluded token holders. Liquidity removal is permanently blocked via an always-reverting beforeRemoveLiquidity. Only the deployer (via tx.origin check) may add liquidity.
